total_cite.quote: The total fee for the services is EUR 12,000.00.

cite.quote: Nordlicht Digital (the "Agency", billing@nordlicht.example) will provide the services.
Alpenmode AG (the "Client", kreditoren@alpenmode.example) engages the Agency.
Subcontractor Lukas Brandt (lukas@brandt.example) shall receive 20% of each milestone payment received by the Agency.
Milestone 1 - Catalog migration: All products migrated, fee EUR 3,000.00, due 2026-11-20. Acceptance criteria: All SKUs imported.
Milestone 2 - Checkout: Checkout and payments, fee EUR 3,500.00, due 2026-12-20. Acceptance criteria: Test orders succeed.
Milestone 3 - Go-live: Production cutover, fee EUR 3,500.00, due 2027-01-20. Acceptance criteria: DNS switched; No P1 incidents for 7 days.

net_days_cite.quote: Each invoice is payable within 21 days of the invoice date.

cite.quote: Overdue amounts accrue a late fee of 1% per month after a grace period of 7 days, capped at EUR 300.00 per invoice.

dispute_clause.quote: Any billing dispute must be raised in writing within 10 days of the invoice date, citing the milestone concerned.
